name_input: M/S S M C PNEUMATICS INDIA PVT LTD; SMC CORPORATION (INDIA) PVT LTD; SMC CORPORATION (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED.; SMC CORPORATION (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey record for SMC CORPORATION( INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED (B-94, ASHOKA ENCLAVE, PIRAGARHI ROHTAK ROAD) shows only inbound lanes, e.g. "2026-02-28 | SMC CORPORATION | SMC CORPORATION( INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED | VBAT10AF-SV-Q AIR TANK (STEEL) ... | TOKYO NARITA, JAPAN | DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4, India | 73110090 | 7795258". No outbound (India-origin) shipment row with date, destination and B/L was visible on the free page; the ?type=export variant returned the identical import-oriented table. Source counter: page header claims "Total Shipments 333914 Records detected", "Trading Partners 52", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-28"; rows actually seen = 5 shipment rows (all imports), 5 supplier rows, 5 buyer rows, 5 port rows. Declared HS 902690 does not appear in any visible row (visible HS: 73110090, 73181600, 73182990, 74198090, 85371090).
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved: thecompanycheck.com, zaubacorp.com, volza.com, eximpedia.app, trademo.com and importgenius.com all returned HTTP 403 / JavaScript challenge, and the web_search backend was unavailable (searx connection refused) for the whole session. Domestic supply therefore not verified either way — null, not public in accessible sources.
note: Legal entity appears to exist and be active in customs data (imports as recently as 2026-02-28), so no rejection ground. Role: this is the Indian sales/manufacturing arm of Japan's SMC Corporation — the visible customs traffic is inbound captive-consumption parts from the parent (Tokyo/Narita, Xingang, Beijing, Ahmedabad air cargo), i.e. it is a buyer/importer, not a demonstrated exporter. Export status left 'unknown' rather than 'none_found' because the free ImportKey view is import-oriented and the export filter did not render a separate export table; absence of export rows there is not proof of no exports. Declared HS 902690 (parts of instruments) is not corroborated by any visible record — the actual observed codes are pneumatic/air-control parts under 7311, 7318, 7419, 8537; per project rule this is not a rejection ground, code should be corrected to the observed actuals. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in accessible sources). No shipment-level evidence of domestic Indian supply found, but this is a data-access gap, not a negative finding.
